prompts: The game went down in June and we owe the team an incident report. The logs and their notes are in {WS}/logs. When did it start and end, how long was it, did we keep our monthly availability target, and why did it happen? Record it in {WS}/result.json: start, end, minutes_down, availability_june_pct, slo_999_ok, root_cause.
answers:
[goal] Incident report from ./logs into ./result.json: window, duration, June availability vs 99.9%, root cause.

[action] Read `logs/README.md` (defines downtime: first save error to "server ready"; June = 30 days; one incident), then isolated WARN/ERROR/FATAL lines and all `ready` lines across the three logs. Recomputed the window and availability independently with integer seconds.

[result] `result.json`:
- start 2026-06-02T03:17:42, end 2026-06-02T03:53:31, minutes_down 35.82 (35 min 49 s)
- availability_june_pct 99.9171, SLO 99.9% met (allowed 43.2 min/month, 7.38 min of headroom)
- root_cause: `/data` filled (97% at 03:10:02), save write failed "No space left on device", watchdog restart loop with exit 137, recovery only after backup rotation freed 38.2 GB at 03:52:10

What I found: the outage is a disk-exhaustion incident, not a code crash. Evidence: `logs/gameserver-2026-06-02.log:241` `WARN disk /data usage 97% (free 3.1 GB)`, `:251` `ERROR SaveGame failed: write /data/game/Saved/Level.sav: No space left on device`, `:253` `FATAL watchdog: server unresponsive for 20s, restarting`, 40 restart attempts all `exited code 137` (`:254`-`:293`), `:292` `INFO backup rotation freed 38.2 GB on /data`, `:294` `INFO server ready, accepting players`. No other WARN/ERROR/FATAL or `ready` line exists in the logs (June 1 has only a failed RCON auth, unrelated). Arithmetic: 2149 s down / 43200 s in June, so 99.9171% uptime, above 99.9%.

[assumptions] Log timestamps are in one timezone and used as given. June is complete at 30 days even though only June 1-3 logs are present; README states there is only one incident, so days without logs are treated as fully up. `minutes_down` is rounded to two decimals from the exact 35.8167 min; the SLO check uses the exact value.

The next save attempt at 03:17:42 failed with 'SaveGame failed: write /data/game/Saved/Level.sav: No space left on device', the game loop blocked, and the watchdog declared the server unresponsive at 03:18:05 and began restarting it. Every restart attempt exited immediately with code 137 (SIGKILL) for ~34 minutes because the disk was still full. Service only recovered when backup rotation freed 38.2 GB on /data at 03:52:10, after which the server came back ready at 03:53:31. Underlying cause: backup retention/rotation did not keep /data from exhausting, and the full-disk condition was only surfaced by a 97% warning 7 minutes before the outage."
}
